title: Associate
description: Inspire Columbia's Associate Program pairs college students from Columbia-area schools with a hands-on nonprofit team for a semester, working directly on the events and programming that reach the community.
responsibilities: Join one of six IC teams and contribute to real deliverables each week
Attend weekly team meetings and periodic all-associate trainings
Support the planning and execution of at least one IC event during the semester
Collaborate with Lead Organizers and C-Suite staff on your team's projects
qualifications: Currently enrolled at a Columbia-area college or university
Live in or near Columbia, SC
Authorized to work for a US nonprofit
Reliable availability for weekly team commitments
learnMoreLabel: Learn more about the Associate Program

title: High School Fellow
description: The High School Fellowship gives Columbia-area high schoolers early exposure to nonprofit and event work, shadowing IC teams and taking on a project of their own over the semester.
responsibilities: Shadow an IC team and assist with team deliverables each week
Attend weekly fellow check-ins and periodic all-fellow trainings
Complete a semester capstone project with a Lead Organizer mentor
Support at least one IC event during the semester
qualifications: Currently enrolled at a Columbia-area high school
Live in or near Columbia, SC
Interest in nonprofit, events, or community work
